Muster Action Atlas

Every action a person can take in Muster: each multisig family and what it lets a room do, every room action, every wallet send. For each one: who acts, exactly what they sign, who learns what and when, and what Muster refuses. Built actions are generated from the running code; declared ones are what Muster would do, from primary sources.

Where the threshold is enforced. Click to filter.

Every field each observer can learn, across every action, and at which step it reaches them. The dark observers are outside the room. The store node's row is on every room-borne action: it sees the topic, the timing, and each frame's epoch number — never an event's contents. It also sees, in the clear today, who asks to join and the full roster at every admit; that is a known gap, tracked as exo-fbc.

◆ marks a row where the families differ. Every family answers the same rows, which is what makes muster feel the same; the answers are what change. The dark rows are what someone outside the room can learn.

Counts are over all families in the registry. Click a value to see those families in the Atlas.

Decisions, 2026-09-23

Where accounts liveIn the room, as disclosed by members. A member discloses an account into the room log, every reader checks the disclosure against the chain, and the room names who disclosed it.
Signers outside musterYes, where the family has a standard format (PSBT, Safe Tx Service JSON, …), and always surfaced: the account chooser says so, and the card marks each outside signer's slot.
No network bindingAccept, with an exposure row on the card. For LEZ, push upstream for a zone tag in the signed message.
Vote-locus costsEach voter pays their own vote transaction for now, so every member needs a funded chain account. A user-configured relayer can come later.
LEZ aggregate keyAccepted as the working assumption for Phase D; it stays marked unverified until a Phase D test proves it.
Threshold ECDSA (MPC)Candidate. Prototype-grade libraries are fine while muster isn't production code. Before real transactions and users, re-choose the library.
